scope: Foreground baseline batch controller and artifact safety
protections: Strict epochs/workers/seeds/batch validation without implicit truncation
START_FROM and SKIP_RUNS validation before any side effects
Whole requested queue artifact and checkpoint verification before GPU preflight
Original train/evaluate sequential subprocess isolation retained
Zero exit code alone cannot mark a model complete
Valid trained-only runs execute evaluate without retraining
Same-project nonblocking filesystem writer lock, not a GPU lock
Metric ranges, checkpoint provenance, paired initialization/dataset checks
Persistent batch_status with current stage, completed, skipped and failure fields
Bounded output tee and cleanup of owned process trees on signals and IO errors

tests.environment: Local Python 3.9 / Windows / Torch 2.8 CPU with existing extracted backend dependencies
tests.linux_signal_path: mock tests passed; no real Linux server test

limitations: No CUDA model training or GPU speed measurement was performed
Server native-backend 1-3 epoch smoke run remains required
Power loss and Linux SIGKILL cannot guarantee Python cleanup or final status publication
Filesystem must support reliable locking and same-filesystem atomic replace
Use a new PROJECT when the saved implementation/protocol differs; never remove old provenance to bypass it
